sources.title: Investor Bulletin: An Introduction to Options
sources.author_organisation: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Office of Investor Education and Assistance
known_locators: Basic Options Terminology > premium paragraph beginning 'The amount of the premium'
What are some of the risks associated with trading options? > option holders paragraph
limitations: Educational bulletin, not a trading strategy and not a source of CITADEL probabilities.
The examples concern listed U.S. stock options; CITADEL must verify applicability to the exact Indian index-option contract.

cards.principle: An option premium depends on moneyness, time to expiry and underlying volatility; underlying direction alone is insufficient evidence for premium response.
valid_conditions: The exact option contract identity and quote are fresh.
failure_conditions: Greeks, volatility, expiry or executable quote inputs are unavailable or stale.
contradictions: A favorable underlying move need not produce the assumed premium response after time, volatility and spread effects.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as a standalone directional signal or probability.
cards.locator: Basic Options Terminology > premium paragraph beginning 'The amount of the premium'
cards.permitted_excerpt: The amount of the premium is determined by several factors
cards.paraphrased_interpretation: Require contract-specific expiry, moneyness, volatility and executable quote evidence before claiming premium confirmation.

cards.principle: An option holder can lose the entire premium; a principle that describes premium drivers does not guarantee a profitable response.
required_evidence: exact premium paid or executable ask
failure_conditions: Risk, costs, or expiry are omitted from the explanation.
contradictions: No source-backed principle alone establishes edge, calibration or a live probability.
when_not_to_use: Do not convert this general risk statement into a setup-specific probability.
cards.locator: What are some of the risks associated with trading options? > option holders paragraph
cards.permitted_excerpt: Option holders risk the entire amount of the premium paid
cards.paraphrased_interpretation: Treat every long-option thesis as loss-capable and require explicit invalidation, cost and expiry evidence.
